notes.subject: brikim nem bilong yu
notes.rationale: בלהות: 'mi mekim yu i kamap het bilong ol narapela' (KJV 'terror') vs 'mi bagarapim yu olgeta' (YLT 'wastes') — Strong's bilong en i tok 'alarm; destruction'.

notes.subject: oltaim olgeta
notes.rationale: לעולם i min oltaim, tasol litral em i 'samting i stap hed' — taim i go long pis.

notes.subject: ol
notes.rationale: ותבקשי em i pasif — 'yu ol i painim yu'; Tok Pisin i nidim ol.

translation: Bai mi mekim ⟨את⟩ yu i kamap brikim nem bilong yu, na yu i no stap moa; na sapos ol i painim yu, bai ol i no inap painim yu gen, oltaim olgeta — Yahwe i tok, Adonai Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: na yu i no stap moa
na sapos ol i painim yu
